acceptanceCriteria: A __mocks__ sibling of the subject module yields JS-SUBJECT-MOCKED; a setupFiles mock of a boundary module yields JS-BOUNDARY-MOCKED; both pinned by tests.
When the setup config is unreadable or unbound the mock facts abstain with a named reason rather than reporting 'not mocked'.
body: Found in V1-1858 (PR #1161, head 2817789aa, corvint build 664). Expected: mocks declared outside the spec file (shared helpers, __mocks__ adjacent dirs, vitest/jest setupFiles) give JS-SUBJECT-MOCKED or JS-BOUNDARY-MOCKED. Actual: nothing is reported, so a subject mocked via __mocks__ looks unmocked.
title: JS/TS hygiene: see mocks set up in helpers, __mocks__ directories and setup files
